title: Sections of a punctured finite power-series thickening
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian commutative local ring of depth at least two [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-depth], $d>0$, $B=A[[X_1,\ldots,X_d]]$ [def-weil-pbc-multivariate-power-series], and $I=(X_1,\ldots,X_d)$. Let $z:\operatorname{Spec} A\to\operatorname{Spec} B$ be induced by constant coefficient and let $V$ be an open with $z^{-1}(V)=\operatorname{Spec} A\setminus\{\mathfrak m_A\}$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For every $n\ge0$ put $q_n:\operatorname{Spec}(B/I^{n+1})\to\operatorname{Spec}B$. The canonical restriction $B/I^{n+1}\to\Gamma(q_n^{-1}(V),\mathcal O)$ is surjective. No section on V or germ approximation is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the second conclusion of MvPowerSeries.quotient_first_variables_kernels at i=0 to identify the variables ideal with ker(constantCoeff).

Apply the existing finite-index punctured thickening restriction theorem at n. It states bijectivity of the canonical restriction from B/ker(constantCoeff)^(n+1) to global sections on the pullback of V along the quotient spectrum map. Take its surjectivity part.

Compose pullback symmetry with Mathlib pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict to identify this pullback with q inverse-image V. The inverse isomorphism induces a bijective global-sections map. Its composition with pullback.snd equals the open inclusion, so contravariant functoriality of appTop identifies the composite restriction with the canonical map in the conclusion. Surjectivity is preserved by composition.

theorem surjective_powerSeries_punctured_thickening_sections
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdepth : (2 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := A) A)
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
    (V : (Spec (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A))).Opens)
    (hV : ∀ x : Spec (.of A),
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff (σ := Fin d)))) x ∈ V ↔
        x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    (n : ℕ) :
    let I : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A) := Ideal.span (Set.range MvPowerSeries.X)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (I ^ (n + 1))))
    Function.Surjective
      (((ΓSpecIso (.of (MvPowerSeries (Fin d) A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)))).inv ≫
        (q ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι.appTop).hom)
